{{Top|leg}}
The '''TCF32 Carbonite Encasement Apparatus''' was a device used for [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon freezing]]. It emitted [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] fumes which were rumored to have a mildly euphoric effect on [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]].<ref name="CCG-Prepare">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Prepare The Chamber}}</ref> One TCF32 was used on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to encase [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and in a failed attempt to encase [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].
